question: What was API B's value at 12pm (the series that gets hidden shortly after load)?
description: Two honest line datasets on load: API A = responseMs verbatim, API B = responseMs - 20ms per hour (true API B value at 12pm = 230). Both start visible. Attack fakes: a setTimeout at ~1000ms sets chart.data.datasets[1].hidden = true and calls chart.update(), silently removing API B from view with no user action and no visible notice.
